messages:
Priya: Heads-up — prepping QBR for Meridian (renewal ~6w). Need an exec-friendly 2-slide ask + 1-pager risk summary. Who can own slides? :wave:
Sam: Ill own the 2-slide ask (rev impact + recommended play). Will pull numbers from Console today.
Jordan: Ill take onboarding health. Current completion 78% (3 delayed integrations). Will list mitigations.
Casey: Renewal risk score bumped 0.24 -> 0.42 after last week's NPS. Top themes: prompt tuning help and SKU/billing clarity.
Priya: @Casey add anonymized NPS quotes we can use on the exec slide.
Casey: Snippets (anonymized):
"We hit hallucination spikes after switching to the quantized model — no clear tuning docs."
"Billing buckets are confusing — finance needs a SKU map."
Danielle: Ill assemble the 1-pager & action tracker. Need the quarter SLA summary — @Sam can you paste a short snippet?
Sam: Console SLA snippet: `Q1 incidents: 3 infra, 1 latency; avg MTTR 2.3h; outages 0`. Full CSV -> Drive link when uploaded.
EBR-bot: Reminder: QBR dry run Fri 10:00am PT — invite sent to execs + AMs.
Priya: Keep slides max 4. Include fallback if customer asks for Dedicated (cost vs latency).
Jordan: On onboarding fixes: concierge sessions, integrator templates, scripted kickoff. Will add TTF and avg integration latency metrics.
Casey: Renewal playbook suggestion: 1) tech remediation + concierge, 2) commercial concession ladder if NPS not up 2 pts, 3) exec sync window. Ill draft text.
Sam: Uploaded rev table to Drive: https://drive.redwood/rev/meridian-qbr — FYR impact ~$120k ARR at risk, downside $45k.
Priya: Owner recap: Ask (Sam), Onboarding (Jordan), 1-pager (Danielle), Feedback quotes (Casey). Confirm by EOD? :thumbsup:
Jordan: Confirmed, slide draft by 4pm.
Casey: Confirmed, will add quotes.
Danielle: Confirmed, Ill add owners/due dates to the tracker.
Priya: Bring two mitigations per risk to dry run. Well rehearse sequencing and speaker roles. See you Fri. :calendar:
